summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Grand Estates 3D, a multiplayer-capable 3D Monopoly web game built with Three.js, real-time WebSocket room synchronization, local pass-and-play with AI bots, an optional Male/Female AI Host with dynamic personalities powered by Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Live API voice chat, and Google Search grounded real-world city landmark trivia.
